assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production text-free monthly illustrated background for a Raspberry Pi calendar dashboard. A flat image, landscape, exactly 1024 by 600 aspect ratio, fill whole canvas.
Art direction for a unified twelve-month collection: sophisticated independent 2D game field journal, hand-painted gouache and woodblock-inspired shapes on warm handmade washi paper. Distinct imperfect edges, sparse charcoal ink contours, subtle visible paper grain, calm restrained detail, balanced asymmetry. No photographic realism, no glossy 3D, no geometric vector icons.
Month: January / Mutsuki. A graceful pine branch with soft clustered needles, a small folded cream-and-rust celebration fan, and one flowing vermilion knotted cord. Feeling of quiet gathering and renewal. Colors: oatmeal cream, sage pine, deep spruce, muted vermilion and a little matte ochre.
Exact composition for overlaid live UI: illustrated pine and cord concentrated along the upper RIGHT edge (x=750..1024,y=0..145) and a small airy pine spray in upper left panel's RIGHT corner (x=320..440,y=0..80). A few light pigment traces along bottom and outer edges. Rich but restrained hand-painted botanical detail in those corners. All central areas are exceptionally quiet pale warm cream paper for dark text: x=0..440,y=80..220; x=0..300,y=0..80; all of x=450..1000,y=100..570. Lower left rectangle x=28..428,y=337..562 will be covered by a separate daily illustration. Keep that rectangle empty paper. No frames, no panels, no straight decorative rules, no repeating border pattern. The illustration must feel part of a beautiful physical almanac, not a wallpaper or a dashboard screenshot.
Text: NONE. Absolutely no letters, numbers, month name, calligraphy, labels, symbols resembling text, calendars, clocks, UI, logos, watermark. No sun or moon discs, no animal characters. Preserve generous negative space.
